decision: Proceed with a conventional rectangular, bolt-only plywood gusset development approach. The earlier same-outline sizing remains a separate unadopted study.
strength_axis: Y, both factory plywood leaves; Group 1, at least five plies, APA Rated Sturd-I-Floor 48 oc, PS 1 plywood. Material specification unobserved.
bolt_count_and_axes: Retain all 100 bolt and 66 Hillman axis lines. Eight cleat stacks change; no new cross-ties, panel screws or field-glue contribution.
action_scope: Transport the complete saved cut wrench to the new rectangle center and each independent leaf. Equal complete-wrench sharing is a sizing hypothesis, not a current response or a bound on physical sharing. New self-weight and contact are not covered.
method: Reuse the published APA allowable capacities and existing rectangular traction/enclosure helpers. Normalize normal stress by the lesser of the applicable membrane and flat-bending references. The positive linear combination is an engineering sizing hypothesis, not a published complete joint equation.
